description: Open one past chat at a conversation_search hit and return a few turns around it. Pass conversation_id "current" to re-read earlier turns of this chat.
name: mcp__claude_ai__read_conversation

conversation_id.description: The chat's UUID, or "current" for this chat. Never guess one.

page_token.description: The hit's page_token, or next/prev page token. Omit to read from the beginning.
